input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for account query, account query, card query. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to interact with card functionality, so that I can accomplish my card-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with client functionality, so that I can accomplish my client-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with controller advice functionality, so that I can accomplish my controller advice-related tasks.
